spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of the Kephalaia: The Kingdom of Fals ity and Evil

---

** ¶2**

Five origins of evil have existed from et ernity in the realm of spiritual darkness. Five fundamental qualities of evil p oured forth from them. And from these five qualities of evil, five kinds of perverted perception were formed . Again , from these five perv erted perceptions, five genera of evil affections were brought forth in each sphere — both as corrupt willing and as corrupt understanding. And the five spher es of evil themselves each contain a ruling evil , an animating falsity, an outward form, and a quality of delight in evil; and in each sphere these do not resemble one another.

---

**¶3**

The ruling principle of the sphere of Obsc uring Falsity — that which arose from the in most depths of spiritual ignorance — this is the governing evil that stands at the head of all wickedness and all malice . The first spreading of spiritual assault against heaven originated through this principle: all conflicts , ag gressions, content ions, per ils , devast ations, struggles , and contests of dom ination. This is the one who first raised up spiritual pe ril and warfare through its subordin ate spher es and its derivative powers. And afterward , it w aged war also against Divine Wisdom itself . It mounted an assault against the Heav enly Kingdom.

---

** ¶4**

Now regarding this ruling principle of all Darkness, there are five forms of evil upon it . Its governing love is the love of fierce dominion over others . Its power and its capacity for action are shaped as pure evil of will , dem onic in nature . Its strength is formed as pred atory intelligence — the rap acious thought that se izes from above . Its interior appropri ation of life is formed as destruct ive falsity consuming all it receives . And its lowest sensory influence is formed as base natural cun ning, cold and sub mer ged. These five forms — being the signatures of its five spheres — exist upon the ruling principle of the real ms of spiritual darkness.

---

**¶ 5**

Now there are five further properties within this principle . The first is its absence of all spiritual light . The second is its corruption and profanation of everything it touches. The third is its spiritual de formity — the utter absence of heav enly form . The fourth is its interior bitterness, which is the very quality of its life . The fifth is its consuming self -love, which burns within it like mol ten iron p oured from a furn ace.

---

**¶ 6**

There are also three further qualities . The first: that its out ward form is imp erv ious and utt erly resistant to truth — even as the merely natural mind, which is the thought of spiritual death, has fash ioned it from the very substance of spiritual ignor ance. This is the nature of the out ward form of the ruler of Obsc uring Falsity. It is harder than every natural power , every natural capacity , every natural strength and density of the unre gen erate mind; for there is no truth that can penet rate it, no instrument of wisdom that can divide or cut through it. For the merely natural mind, its maker , has fashioned it to be u nyielding and imperv ious to all reformation .

---

**¶7 **

The second: that it wounds and destro ys through the persu asive power of its perv erted reasoning. Its inc antations and doc trines, all its foolish instruction , produce de ceptions and false ench antments in its service . When it w ills, it can turn its persu asion in ward upon itself and , through the art of fals ified reasoning, hide its true nature even from its own derivative powers. Again, when it wills , it can project itself over all its subordin ate ev ils and appear manifest to them.

---

**¶8**

The third: that this ruling principle of all Darkness compreh ends the discourse and communication of all its five spheres. It understands everything it receives from their expressions , as each addresses the other in its own mode of fals ity. Every design they may conce ive against it, every strat agem they deliber ate among themselves to bring upon it, it perce ives. It can also understand the hidden signals they make between themselves . Yet its derivative powers and subordin ate rulers , who are subject to it, cannot comprehend its own mode of communication . And while all out ward things are laid bare before it — still, the interior will of its subjects is not open to it. It knows neither their genuine intention nor their thought ; it cannot f athom their origin nor their end. Rather, it only knows and g rasps what stands immediately present before its perception .

---

**¶9 **

Also another quality is found in this ruling principle. When it wills to extend its influence , it spreads all its fac ulties out ward and moves through its domain . When it w ills otherwise , it withdraw s its fac ulties and g athers them inward, and is contracted into a dense mass among its companions — falling upon the lowest natural plane like a single compressed fruit or a great ball of imp enetrable natural power . It terrifies by its outc ry; it is d readful. It frightens its subordin ate powers with its sound, because when it speaks, it is like the overwhelming persu asion of powerful falsity rever berating through obsc ured states of mind — it resembles the s hattering of what was thought to be firm and established . When it cries out over its powers, they tr emble and t otter and fall prost rate, even as lesser aff ections are overcome and cast down to the lowest natural plane. Yet this one thing remains : it knows not what is remote from it in spiritual states; it perce ives not what is at a distance, nor can it app rehend it . Rather, only whatever stands immediately before its presence does it see, hear , and know.

---

** ¶10**

These signs and these marks of evil are found in the chief of all evil aff ections and destruct ive falsities — the ruling principle of all the ex alted states of spiritual darkness — the one to whom the realm of spiritual ignor ance gave birth, begotten in its cruel ty, in its wickedness, and in its wrath.

---

** ¶11**

It exce eds in all these qualities every fellow ruling evil throughout all its spher es.

---

**¶12**

The sem blance of the highest good — self -love appearing as if it were love itself — is the out ward form of the ruler of all Darkness. The out ward form of all the derivative powers belonging to the sphere of Obscuring Falsity likewise w ears this semblance of the good of love. And the quality of de light in its works is the cr aving to preserve its own evil states unchanged .

---

**¶13 **

In contrast, the ruling principle of the sphere of Self -Love is shaped as fierce dominion, the fore most of all the natural aff ections of power . Its outward form is natural good perv erted to sel fish ends . Again , the outward form of all the rulers belonging to Self -Love is natural good thus perverted. Their quality of delight is the sour ness of a version — the turning of all things to b itterness — that is found in every out ward expression of this sphere .

---

**¶14 **

Again , the ruling principle of the sphere of Perv erted Reasoning is shaped as predatory intelligence. Its outward form is hard natural power, u nyielding. Also , the outward form of all who belong to Perverted Reasoning is this same hard ened power. Their quality of delight is the sh arpness that cuts and divides — the divis ive falsity that is found in every expression of this sphere.

---

** ¶15**

For its part, the ruling principle of the sphere of Corrupted Knowledge is shaped as base sens ory cun ning. Its outward form is fals ity that appears as truth — seem ing bright and pure . All the other rulers who belong to this sphere likewise bear the form of falsity appearing as truth. And the quality of delight in their works is the sweetness of enticement — the se ductive pleas ant ness that draws the natural mind toward falsity in every expression of this sphere.

---

** ¶16**

Again, the ruling principle of the sphere of Fundamental Ignor ance is shaped as the great destroying falsity itself . Its outward form is dense, base falsity dev oid of all genuine substance — heavy and without light . All the other rulers belonging to this deep est sphere likewise bear this form of le aden, subst anceless falsity. And the quality of delight in their works is the bitterness that rep els all good and po isons all truth.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Five storehouses have arisen since the beginning in the land of darkness! The five elements poured out of them. Also, from the five elements were fashioned the five trees! Again, from the five trees were fashioned the five genera of creatures in each world, male and female. And the five worlds themselves have five kings therein, and five spirits, five bodies, five tastes; in each world, they not resembling one another!

The King of the world of Smoke [is the chief of all the five kings, he] who came up from the depth of darkness; this is he who is the head of all wickedness, and all malignity. The beginning of the spread of the war occured through him; all the battles, fights, quarrelling, dangers, destructions, fights, wrestling-contests! That is the one who first made arise danger and war, with his worlds and his powers. Afterwards, also, he waged war with the light. He pitched a battle with the exalted kingdom.

Now, regarding the King of Darkness, there are five shapes on him! His head is lion-faced; his hands and feet are demon- and devil-faced; his shoulders are eagle-faced; while his belly is dragon-faced; his tail is fish-faced. These five shapes, the marks of his five worlds, exist on the King of the realms of Darkness!

Now, there are five other properties in him. The first is his darkness. The second is his putridity. The third is his ugliness. The fourth is his bitterness, his own soul. The fifth is his burning, which burns like an iron () as if poured out from fire.

[There are] also three others in him! The first, that his body is hard and very tough, even as she has formed him [to be fierce and] cruel-hearted; namely Matter, who is the thought of death, [the o]ne who sculpted him from the nature of the land of darkness. This is the manner of the body of the ruler of Smoke. He is harder than every iron, copper and steel and lead; as there is no cleaver at all, nor any iron implement, can [pierce] him and cut him. For Matter, his fashioner, has formed him [to be exceedingly] strong and hard.

The second, that he wounds and kills by the word of his magic arts. His recitation and hearing, all his foolish instruction, make magic and invocations for him. When it pleases him, he can make an invocation over himself, and by his magic arts be hidden from his companions. Again, when it pleases him, he can be manifested over his powers and appear to them;

The third, that the King of the realms of Darkness knows the converse and language of his five worlds. He understands every thing he hears from their mouths, as they address one another; each one of them in his language. [Every] design they will consider against him, every snare they debate with one another to bring upon him, he knows them! He can also understand the gesturing they signal between one another. Yet, his powers and his rulers, who are subject to him, can not understand his wordy converse. While all these things are unveiled to him; still, their heart is not manifested to him. He knows not their mind nor their thought; he can not ponder their beginning and their end. Rather, he only knows and apprehends what is before his eyes.
[He is mightier in all these evil qualities] more than all his fellow rulers, who are in all his worlds.
Gold is the body of the King of the realms of Darkness. The body of all the powers who belong to the world of Smoke is gold. And also, the taste of its fruits is salty.

In contrast, the King of the worlds of Fire is lion-faced, the foremost of all the beasts. Copper is his body. Again, the body of all the rulers who belong to Fire is copper. Their taste is the sour taste that is in every form.
Again, the King of the worlds of Wind is eagle-face. His body is iron. Also, the body of all they who belong to the Wind is iron. Their taste is the sharp taste that is in every form.

For his part, the King of the world of Water is fish-face. His body is silver. All the other rulers who belong to Water, silver is their body. Also, the taste of their fruit is the sweetness of water, the sweet taste that is in every (form).

Again, [the Kin]g of the world of Darkness is a dragon. His [body is lead] and tin. All the other rulers [who belong to the world of] Darkness, their body is lead and tin. And also, the taste of their fruits is bitterness.

Also, another different thing is found in the King of the realms of Darkness! For when it pleases him to move, he spreads all his limbs out and walks. When it comes to mind, he with[d]raws his limbs and takes them in, and is rolled (?) to his companions; and he falls to the ground like a grape and a great iron ball! He terrifies by his cry, he is frightful. He frightens his powers with his sound; because when he speaks, being like thunder in the clouds, he resembles the [ ... ] of the rocks [ ... ] When he cries out and [ ... ] and calls [ ... ] over his powers, they shall tremble and to[tter a]nd fall under foot; even as some birds would be [ ... ] the bird [ ... / ... ] and they fall down to the earth. Still, this thing only: he knows not what is far from him, he sees not who is at a distance, nor does he hear him. Rather, whoever is before his face he sees, hearing him and knowing him.

These signs and these evil marks are found in the chief of the demons and fiends, the King of all the mountains of Darkness [ ... the one] to [whom] the land of darkness has given birth, begotten in its cruelty, in its wickedness and its wrath [ ... ]
